title: Qwen-Audio-3.1-ASR Technical Report
abstract: arXiv:2610.28711v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present Qwen-Audio-3.1-ASR, a family of audio-language models that builds upon its predecesor Qwen-Audio-3.0-ASR with improved speech recognition and expanded capabilities in speaker-diarized transcription and general audio understanding. The family retains support for 30 languages and 16 Chinese dialects, together with instruction-controlled capabilities including historical-context conditioning, hierarchical hotword customization, and native transcription polishing. Speaker-diarized ASR produces structured outputs containing speaker labels, timestamps, and recognized text, maintaining consistent speaker labels across turns and the representation of overlapping speech. The general audio understanding capabilities cover audio-, speech-, and music-captioning, temporal grounding and sound event detection, as well as audio question answering and multiple-choice reasoning. These tasks broaden the application scope from recognizing spoke

translated_abstract: 我们推出了 Qwen-Audio-3.1-ASR，这是一系列音频-语言模型，在其前代模型 Qwen-Audio-3.0-ASR 的基础上改进了语音识别能力，并扩展了说话人分离转录和通用音频理解能力。该系列模型保留了对 30 种语言和 16 种中国方言的支持，同时具备指令控制能力，包括历史上下文条件化、分层热词定制以及原生转录润色。说话人分离 ASR 能够生成包含说话人标签、时间戳和识别文本的结构化输出，在多轮对话中保持说话人标签的一致性，并能表示重叠语音。通用音频理解能力涵盖音频、语音和音乐描述生成、时间定位与声音事件检测，以及音频问答和多选题推理。这些任务将应用范围从识别口语内容进一步拓宽。
tldr: Qwen-Audio-3.1-ASR 系列音频-语言模型在改进语音识别的基础上，扩展了说话人分离转录和通用音频理解能力，支持 30 种语言和 16 种中国方言。
en_tdlr: Qwen-Audio-3.1-ASR is a family of audio-language models that improves speech recognition while extending to speaker-diarized transcription and general audio understanding, supporting 30 languages and 16 Chinese dialects.
